ruleDefinitions.name: Firewall Changes Linux
ruleDefinitions.description: This rule detects attempts to change firewall settings using 'ufw' or 'iptables' commands. This could indicate an attacker trying to manipulate network traffic.

sequences.query: activity_type:"process-create" AND (process_command_line:("ufw","iptables") AND process_command_line:(" disable"," allow"," -a input"," -d input"," accept"))
